about_the_game:
Qume: Echoes of Sand
Once a vibrant and thriving world, it is now covered by an endless desert. Qume: Echoes of Sand offers an open-world experience combining survival, exploration, and combat.

The World Transformed Into a Desert, Fight to Survive
As you struggle to survive among dust-covered, abandoned cities and lost civilizations, everything can change at any moment. Explore vast desert landscapes, uncover ancient ruins, and gather scarce resources to determine your fate.

Crafting, Exploration, and Looting
Qume features a deep crafting system. You'll need to craft weapons and equipment from the materials you gather. With every step, new tools and resources await in the ancient ruins you discover. However, there’s a price to pay. Locals and other survivors won’t share the same resources. Defeat enemies, loot, and survive!

Combat and Strategy
You are not alone; waiting in the desert are enemies, other survivor groups, and wild animals. Develop your own strategies to survive, both alone and with a group. Combat will be a cornerstone of the survival challenge.

Choose Your Own Path
Every step you take gives you a choice. Do you head towards a safe area, or risk it all in the dangerous desert for rewards? Defeat enemies, gather resources, survive, and dominate the desert!

Endless Exploration
Qume: Echoes of Sand offers a vast world to explore. Every corner holds a new experience, every lost city tells a different story. Surviving in the desert’s depths will force you to unlock the secrets of a whole new world.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent combat with depictions of blood and violence. Players engage in gunfights and melee combat against human and non-human enemies. Some scenes may be intense for sensitive players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K veya AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 veya AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 veya AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super veya AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: The world has been buried in dust. For those left behind, the sand is quieter than death. Become one of the survivors in Qume and uncover the secrets hidden behind the silence.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Russian, Turkish
